latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the Need Type Classifier skill for B2B and enterprise sales contexts.

- Enables classification of customer statements as Implied Needs (problems/difficulties) or Explicit Needs (wants/intentions) based on SPIN Selling methodology.
- Designed for use during call reviews, needs log building, pre-demo checks, and coaching sessions.
- Prevents common mistake of misreading Implied Needs as buying signals in large sales.
- Provides clear next-move recommendations for each statement: develop, convert, or capitalize.
- Default behavior assumes large-sale context for safety if deal size is unspecified.
- Not intended for generating SPIN questions or drafting benefit statements (covered by separate skills).
